description: A project whose transform is `@swc/jest` and whose `jest.mock` factory reads `window` and a module-scope variable not prefixed `mock` (`suffix`), under `testEnvironment: 'jsdom'`. The preset's one entry takes `.js`, `.ts`, `.tsx` and `.jsx` (the recorder's own transform still takes the `.ts` files first under Jest). SWC's jest transform hoists the call and checks nothing, so Jest 30.5.2 runs the factory and both tests pass: the out-of-scope check is babel-plugin-jest-hoist's, which only babel-jest runs (`cli/transform-babel-jest-factory-scope` is the same test under babel-jest). Read by `provino`'s `transform-factory-scope.test.ts`. A black-box run.
